matched_native_strata.selection_basis: High-priority East Asian coverage probe with substantial current BCI translation/product activity and high local-language source dependence.
Known Japanese first-party NeuroAI product evidence plus a mature research/medical-technology source environment.
High-priority East Asian coverage probe with Korean EEG/research-product evidence and likely local-language discovery gain.
Current controlled developer evidence includes multiple Spanish NeuroAI developers and Spanish-language product documentation.

change_control: Additional languages may be explored supplementally, but changing the primary v1.0 matched strata requires a preregistration successor before headline multilingual sensitivity is recomputed.
boundary: This scope measures discovery sensitivity in selected language/jurisdiction strata; it is not a claim that other languages or jurisdictions are unimportant.
